question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is placed at MN as shown below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71d116ae78dc8a380bf08b5065980c4726c843a61a05644f431020acee0102c4.png]
solution:
The correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is held on the right side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eed303d6a79a579d5201da71884fa0ceeab2e179319a2405bad90d1b131b5c59.png] 

__Detailed Explanation:__

__
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8871e5a84018e99eea567fa48863215fd8eaa42e36a7629964e95c57bc5b9578.png] " the seventh alphabet of the given image is '**U**' but it is wrongly given in Option 2 so it is eliminated.
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8871e5a84018e99eea567fa48863215fd8eaa42e36a7629964e95c57bc5b9578.png] " the second alphabet of the given image is '**U**' but it is wrongly given in Option 4 so it is eliminated.
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8871e5a84018e99eea567fa48863215fd8eaa42e36a7629964e95c57bc5b9578.png] " the first letter of the given image is '**N**' and the correct mirror image of this alphabet is ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4c3eda0ff2b05ba8da26ecf05ff05c21eaa40f4447e3e43cb327b25f1b31951.png] ' but it is wrongly given in Option 3 so it is eliminated.

 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

1) In the mirror image left side and right side changed vice-versa where the top and bottom remain the same.

2) In a real given mirror image the farthest number or alphabet appears closest in the mirror image.
